value.rationale: The exact thermal phase boundary distinguishes a pair of physically observable active-accumulation peaks from a single thermalized central peak over all switching/trap ratios and temperatures. The result adds unique global criticality, a nontrivial hypergeometric characterization, quartic critical shape, and limits, none of which is the mere known stationary convolution or an arbitrary parameter slice.
